value: 淫勇クエスト～敵にも仲間にも搾られまくるRPG～
Fully voice-acted femdom RPG with a handful of size focused characters

Twenty years have passed since the succubi began their conquest on the world. The hero sets out to defeat the Demon Queen- a powerful succubus- on his own, but is easily defeated by her pheromones and branded with a mark that makes him uncontrollably aroused. With the help of allies, will he be able to reach the Demon Queen once again and save the world?
